scenes.setting: Inside the villa unseen: testing Dark-Emperor-boosted Spirit-Body strength against the gas pipes, mapping the golden hall and dining room — then, leaning on a sunset oil painting, the Biological Poison Bottle is silently uncapped into the sealed dinner air
scenes.text_anchor: It was the Biological Poison Bottle!

scenes.setting: The dinner turns nightmare: Capim scratches his face open into pus, servants laugh and vomit themselves unconscious; Harras Imprisons and Katy shoots — but hits a paper substitute; lights die, a Specter's Shriek bloodies Katy's nose, and a freezing hand Imprisons Parker with Harras's own borrowed word before Harras snarls 'Release!'
scenes.text_anchor: “Katy, follow me to find the intruder!”
